This '''[[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]''' was present on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the hunt for [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]. This individual was seen firing at Vos from a high vantage point, after which the Gand was not seen again.
